purpose: Resolve registered evidence to verified local image bytes without deriving observations from labels.

manifest.file_name_resolution: Only the registered simple file_name is joined to the configured evidence root; repo_target_path is validated metadata and is never used as an arbitrary filesystem path.

security.url_and_ssrf: Rejected as manifest or evidence path input; no HTTP client exists in the module.
security.safe_root: Resolved root must exist and be a directory; resolved candidate must remain inside it.
security.symlinks: The final resolved target is checked against the safe root; out-of-root resolution is rejected.
integrity: Content SHA-256 is computed from bytes read from the resolved file.
Manifest byte length, MIME, dimensions and SHA-256 must all match.
PNG signatures, chunk CRCs, zlib scanlines and filters are checked.
JPEG frame markers, dimensions, entropy termination and bounded trailing data are checked.

failure_behavior.model_call: The resolver has no ModelProvider dependency; a failed resolution raises before a consumer can submit provider bytes.

test_asset_policy: backend/tests/images creates explicitly synthetic minimal PNG/JPEG bytes in temporary directories. The five X-A-IMAGES files are input-validation evidence only and are never copied into test fixtures.
